summary: The MPC left Bank Rate at 3.75% on a 6-3 vote; the three dissenters wanted a 25bp increase, to 4%. The meeting ended on 29 July 2026 and the decision was published on 30 July 2026. Inflation was 2.6%, lower than at the previous meeting. previous_bank_rate equals bank_rate because the rate was unchanged.
